nightly-bot: :rotating_light: Nightly eval failure for model q4_2b (git: release/quant-qkernels). Failed suites: promptset_invoice (drop ~12%), longctx_coherence (incoherence spike), safety_policy (unsafe gen rate up). Severity: MEDIUM — escalating to eng-ml. Thread id: 4460001234
maria: looking now — any recent quant/kernel changes merged that could explain this?
ken: i merged an optimization PR yesterday (PR #8216) that tweaks kernel fp->int mapping for perf. will check if it regresses tails.
raj: quick metrics snapshot:
```text
model: q4_2b
promptset_invoice: baseline 92.1 -> 80.2 (-11.9)
longctx_coherence: avg 0.87 -> 0.65
safety_policy: unsafe rate 0.3% -> 1.9%
commit: 7d4c9a4
```
sasha: @oncall any active rollouts? we should pause new deployments and pin hosted to previous stable until we triage.
oncall: no active canaries, dedicated pools got the image at 03:40 UTC. pausing release now and removing traffic from the new version.
maria: assigning owners: @ken (quant kernel), @raj (eval slices), @sasha (prod ops). initial severity P2 — if safety > 1% escalate to P1.
ken: starting reproduce on int4 config locally, kicking off A/B against int8 baseline + baseline quant kernels. will try to get minimal repro.
raj: i'll run focused eval slices (invoices, contract-clauses, longctx docs) and dump top failing examples. sharing first failing example below.
maria: paste representative example (redacted):
- prompt: "Summarize the invoice lines and highlight discrepancies."
- baseline: lists all items and amounts
- q4_2b: omits the second line and fabricates a 'late fee' entry that doesn't exist
sasha: i'm creating an incident doc and will add failing examples + owner tags. also putting a temporary rollout freeze.
oncall: created #inc-4460001234 and invited sec for the safety spike, adding heartbeat checks for unsafe-gen rate.
maria: plan: ken produce minimal repro + kernel diff, raj gather failing prompts & metric deltas, sasha hold rollout and add incident notes, oncall monitor. re-check in 1 hour in this thread.
ken: update: local run shows mismatch in softmax fallback for sequences >1024, looks like an index boundary in optimized kernel. replicating now.
raj: shared eval gist (internal): https://internal.gists/runs/4460001234/q4_2b-failures — contains examples, metric deltas, and raw outputs.
sasha: thanks — freeze enforced, no model pushes until triage clears.
oncall: ack. monitoring alert thresholds and will escalate if safety crosses 2% or promptset drops worsen.
maria: scheduling quick smoke re-run in 35m. if fails again we rollback hosted and notify customers. follow-up here after smoke run.
ken: will post repro snippet here once available.
